summary: Precious metal prices have declined significantly from their peaks amid a confluence of higher interest rates, large budget deficits, persistent inflation, and heightened geopolitical risk. Despite gold falling over 20% and silver, platinum, and palladium dropping more than 40% from January 2026 highs, prices remain 24-100% above early 2025 levels. Four key forces--fiscal deficits, above-target inflation, Middle East and Eastern Europe conflicts, and central bank gold buying--are preventing even steeper declines.
